_comment: Hand-curated metadata for files in /apps. Keys are the repository path
(or just the file name). Anything omitted is inferred from the file name
by assets/js/lib/metadata.js, so this file is entirely optional.
Supported fields: title, description, subject, years (array),
tags/keywords (array — synonyms), topic, resourceType, language, owner,
department, academicYear, visibility (public | school | class), version,
`addedAt` is an ISO date/time (e.g. 2026-10-01T09:15:00Z) saying when the
resource joined the library. The dashboard uses it to show a green
"Latest" badge for the first 24 hours, "Yesterday" the day after, and the
plain date from then on, and to sort newest resources to the top.
Approved teacher uploads set it automatically.
`title` is the resource's real, human-readable name and always wins over
the file name: 16G.pdf tells a student far less than a proper title.
Entries produced by the teacher upload workflow can be copied straight
from the Review Submissions screen ("Copy metadata").
